The Denver Broncos will be without cornerback Pat Surtain II against this week as they take on the Arizona Cardinals, but reports suggest he will make his return next week in that critical AFC West home game against the Kansas City Chiefs. Still no Talanoa Hufanga either. Hopefully we see him back next week as well.
 The good news is that the Broncos have gotten both running back Jonah Coleman and edge rusher Jonathon Cooper back and both are active for this game.
